questions.q: What does "fully managed, serverless" mean for the Azure integration runtime?
options: No infrastructure to provision, patch, or size — you just use it
It requires manual VM provisioning before each run
You must install it on a Windows machine yourself
It only works with SQL Server sources
questions.explain: The Azure IR is Data Factory's own managed compute — created automatically, with no patching, provisioning, or manual scaling on your part.

questions.q: For a Copy activity with a detectable sink location, which region does autoresolve use?
options: The same region as the sink, or the closest one in the same geography
Always the data factory's own region, regardless of the sink
A randomly selected region each run
Whichever region has the lowest cost that day
questions.explain: Autoresolve makes a best effort to detect the sink's region and run the copy there (or nearby) — it's not random, but a real, predictable pattern.

questions.q: What controls a Copy activity's scaling on the Azure IR?
options: Data integration units (DIUs), which scale the underlying compute elastically
Manually resizing the integration runtime itself
The number of pipeline parameters
Copy activities can't be scaled at all on the Azure IR
questions.explain: Setting DIUs on a Copy activity elastically scales the compute behind it — no explicit IR resizing required.

questions.q: Which activities always run in the data factory's own region, regardless of where the data lives?
options: Lookup, GetMetadata, and Delete
Copy activities, always
Data Flow activities, always
None — every activity's region is autoresolved based on the data
questions.explain: Lookup, GetMetadata, and Delete activities run in the data factory's own region, unlike Copy (which follows the sink) or Data Flow (which also uses the factory's region but for different reasons).

questions.q: Why would you use connectVia to pin a linked service to a specific regional Azure IR?
options: For strict data compliance requirements where autoresolve's "best effort" detection isn't a strong enough guarantee
It's required for every linked service, with no exceptions
To make a pipeline run faster in every scenario
connectVia only works with self-hosted integration runtimes
questions.explain: When data genuinely can't leave a specific geography, explicitly pinning both source and sink linked services to a regional IR guarantees the data stays there — autoresolve alone doesn't provide that guarantee.
